ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: IS 585 (Introduction to Bibliographic Metadata, formerly IS 507) and consent of instructor, email your request to bothmann@illinois.edu. Seminar on theoretical and applied approaches to cataloging, including the creation and management of complex descriptive and subject metadata. Topics include current developments in conceptual models for bibliographic materials; information processing and mapping; socio-cultural and critical warrant; and ethical foundations of information organization. Students will engage critically with principles and practices in the application of bibliographic standards in a variety of contexts.
